start.title: [TODO:fr] They Come With Questions
start.text:
[TODO:fr] Pharisees draw near in the temple.
Their eyes are sharp.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Truth has no need to flinch.
[TODO:fr] Do not flee from honest light.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Do Not Hide
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Truth does not run.
Stand and listen.

insult_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Lower Your Voice
insult_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Wisdom answers without shouting.
Be still.

trap_question.title: [TODO:fr] Is It Lawful?
trap_question.text:
[TODO:fr] "Is it lawful to pay tax
to Caesar, or not?"

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The trap closes on quick answers.

shout_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Wait and Watch
shout_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Loud words feed the trap.
Let wisdom speak.

coin.title: [TODO:fr] Whose Image?
coin.text:
[TODO:fr] He lifts a coin. "Whose face
and name are on this?"

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Refuse to even look at it
[TODO:fr] Lie that the coin is yours

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] See and Hear
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] You cannot answer with closed eyes.
Look again.

lie_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Speak True
lie_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Lies will not silence them.
Only truth will.

authority.title: [TODO:fr] Render to God
authority.text:
[TODO:fr] "Give Caesar what is his,
and God what is God's."

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Mock the wisdom as too clever

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Honor the Truth
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] What you mock you cannot learn.
Receive it.

greatest_commandment.title: [TODO:fr] Which Is Greatest?
greatest_commandment.text:
[TODO:fr] "Teacher, which commandment
in the law is greatest?"

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Guess the food and feast laws
[TODO:fr] Listen for love of God and man
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The whole law in one breath.

guess_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Listen Deeper
guess_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] The greatest is not a small rule.
It is love.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Listen for love of God and man

deaf_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Hear Him
deaf_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Truth knocks gently.
Let it in.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Listen for love of God and man

hypocrisy.title: [TODO:fr] Outside Clean
hypocrisy.text:
[TODO:fr] "You wash the cup outside,
but inside you are full of pride."

defend_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Look Within
defend_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] He speaks to your heart, too.
Receive the mirror.

crowd_amazed.title: [TODO:fr] They Marvel
crowd_amazed.text:
[TODO:fr] The crowd stands still in wonder.
No one can trap him.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Stay silent in awe with them
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Wonder is the start of wisdom.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Boast that you knew all along
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Wonder, not pride, is the path.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Be Humble
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Boasting closes the wonder.
Stand quietly.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Stay silent in awe with them

truth_remains.title: [TODO:fr] Truth Stands
truth_remains.text:
[TODO:fr] The Pharisees turn and leave.
His words remain in the air.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Carry his truth in your heart
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Truth makes a home in you.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Forget it before you go home
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Do not let truth slip away.

forget_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Remember
forget_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Truth is a lamp.
Do not blow it out.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Carry his truth in your heart

ending.title: [TODO:fr] Wisdom That Cannot Be Trapped
ending.text:
[TODO:fr] Where manipulation is loud,
truth remains, quiet and bright.
